title: Rename a display
summary: Change a display's name from HQ Admin or from the Retail Admin staff tablet so it describes where the screen sits in the store.
bodyMd:
The display name is what store staff see when a visitor interacts with a screen, so it must say where the screen is: Branch Entrance, Concierge Kiosk, Window Left. You can rename a display from HQ Admin or, for the staff's own store, from Retail Admin. Allow about 1 minute.

Before you begin

  • HQ Admin: an account with permission to manage displays and devices.
  • Retail Admin: a staff login for the store the display is in. See Sign in to the Retail Admin site (no SAML/SSO).

In HQ Admin

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. Find the display, filtering by Store Name if the list is long.
  3. Select the display's Name. The Display Details tab opens.
  4. In Display Name, enter the new name.
  5. Select Save Changes.

In Retail Admin

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices → Manage Displays.
  2. Select Edit.
  3. In the display's row, open the … menu and select View Display Details.
  4. In Display Name, enter the new name.
  5. Select Save Changes.

Verify it worked

The new name appears in the Name column of Displays & Devices in HQ Admin and in the Display column of Manage Displays in Retail Admin.
